why: Luca, 18 Oct 2026 WIB (17 Oct UTC), on 1001startup.id/startups: "need to improve this - sumopod (check saudi startup) - netra runtime (check init6) - get more and more legit startups". Slice 1 is the two companies he named, researched to the census tests on 17 Oct 2026 UTC. SumoPod's founder lives in Madinah, but the company that runs it is Indonesian (PT Koding Kreasi Indonesia, Semarang). Netra Runtime's own site names Init 6 as its backer.

rows.name: SumoPod
rows.sector: Cloud hosting — self-serve container platform and low-cost virtual private servers for Indonesian developers: ready-made app templates such as n8n and WhatsApp gateways that deploy in about 15 seconds, plus an AI model API, billed in rupiah and run on Jakarta-region capacity from cloud partners
rows.hq_address: Forus Space, Jl. Semeru Raya No. 22, Gajahmungkur, Semarang, Jawa Tengah 50231
rows.employees_note: LinkedIn lists 11 people on the page of KodingWorks, the trading name of PT Koding Kreasi Indonesia, the company that operates SumoPod (read 17 Oct 2026; self-declared size band 11-50). SumoPod's own LinkedIn page lists one person, its founder Ariaseta Setia Alam. The census counts the company, as it does for Momofin, so the figure is the company's. The same company also builds software under the KodingWorks name, and how many of the 11 work on SumoPod is not published.
rows.funding_note: No funding round for SumoPod or PT Koding Kreasi Indonesia has been announced. Its founder spent four months of 2023 in Riyadh as an entrepreneur in residence in Antler's programme there; that was a role, not an investment in SumoPod, which launched in 2025.
rows.verify_note: Test 1 (venture-built): SumoPod is a self-serve cloud product, not a services contract: developers sign up, top up in rupiah and deploy containers from ready-made templates (n8n, WhatsApp gateways, AI agents) or rent virtual private servers, and it also resells access to AI models by API. Its founder, Ariaseta Setia Alam, wrote on his blog on 14 Apr 2026 that it reached 50,000 users in its first twelve months. It is operated by PT Koding Kreasi Indonesia, which has traded since 2019 as KodingWorks, a Semarang company that builds software for clients as well as its own products (Warung.io online-store templates, an HR app, a crypto exchange and payment gateway); its business listing calls it a software agency. SumoPod is counted because the company now sells it at scale as a product of its own; if SumoPod stops being the main business, the agency side is a reason to revisit the row. No funding round is on record. Test 2 (own entity): SumoPod's Terms of Service say the platform is operated by PT Koding Kreasi Indonesia. The company register (AHU number 1084866, read through the companieshouse.id mirror) lists PT Koding Kreasi Indonesia as recently active with a registered address on Jl. Candi Penataran Selatan, Semarang. The company's Warung.io site and the KodingWorks LinkedIn page give its working office as Forus Space, Jl. Semeru Raya No. 22, Semarang 50231, which is the address used here. Test 3 (headcount): LinkedIn shows 11 people on the KodingWorks page on 17 Oct 2026 (band 11-50); SumoPod's own page shows only its founder. Geography: the row is counted in Semarang, Central Java, where the operating company is registered and its team works. The founder lives in Madinah, Saudi Arabia: his LinkedIn headline reads "Founder Sumopod | Build Startup @ Madinah", and the SumoPod page places its one listed member there. In December 2025 he wrote that he was pursuing Saudi Arabia's startup route to premium residency and planning separate businesses in Madinah (umrah transport and catering). None of that makes SumoPod a Saudi company: no Saudi entity for SumoPod was found, its terms name the Indonesian company, it bills in rupiah and its servers are in Jakarta. A 2026 profile on Finlup Tech calls it an Indonesian product used as far as Malaysia, with Saudi Arabia only a planned market. Liveness: sumopod.com answered on 17 Oct 2026; in the week before, its LinkedIn page posted a DeepSeek price change and its Threads account posted notices about a Cloudflare disruption affecting n8n and other apps in its Jakarta region; its founder spoke about SumoPod at AIClub Indonesia's Builder's Story on 9 Oct 2026 and at a Dicoding DevCoach workshop on 12 Sep 2025. Doubtful: how much of the 11-person team works on SumoPod; the 50,000-user figure is the founder's own and is not audited. Namesakes: none found.

rows.name: Netra Runtime
rows.sector: AI infrastructure — inference engine that runs open AI models faster on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs, sold as a managed per-token API (Netra Cloud) or licensed to run on an organisation's own GPU servers
rows.hq_address: Jakarta Selatan, DKI Jakarta (no street address published)
rows.employees_note: LinkedIn lists 3 people on the company page (read 17 Oct 2026; self-declared size band 2-10), the same three people the company's About page shows as its team. A very small, very new team.
rows.funding_note: Netra Runtime's own About page says "We're backed by Init 6", the Jakarta fund of Bukalapak co-founders Achmad Zaky and Nugroho Herucahyono. Neither the company nor the fund has announced the round, its size or its date, so the funding figure stays a dash.
rows.last_round: Backed by Init-6 — round and amount not announced
rows.verify_note: Test 1 (venture-built): Netra Runtime builds its own AI inference engine, software that makes open AI models run faster on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs, and sells it two ways: Netra Cloud, a managed API billed per token from prepaid credits, and private deployment on an organisation's own GPU servers. Its About page says "We're backed by Init 6", the Jakarta fund of Bukalapak co-founders Achmad Zaky and Nugroho Herucahyono, which backs 20 other companies in this census. Its engineering is public: on 22 Aug 2026 it open-sourced hand-written kernels for AMD Instinct MI350X GPUs (the netra-kernel repository, MIT licence) with a benchmark of 81,331 output tokens per second for Qwen3.6-35B on eight MI350X GPUs, which is the company's own measurement. Test 2 (own entity): PT Netra Runtime Indonesia signed a memorandum of understanding in Jakarta on 6 Oct 2026 with PT Sivali Catur Lestari (Sivali Cloud Technology) to offer Netra's inference through Sivali's ORCA Hub and to build a federated-compute model in which GPU owners supply capacity; Metro TV News, JPNN, VIVA and Warta Ekonomi (9-10 Oct 2026) name Rifky Bujana Bisri as its president director (Direktur Utama). The site footer reads "© 2026 Netra Runtime, Inc", which suggests a holding company as well; no source says where it is registered. The site carries a Komdigi electronic-system (PSE) registration badge and takes payment through DOKU, an Indonesian payment gateway. Test 3 (headcount): LinkedIn shows 3 people on 17 Oct 2026 (band 2-10), matching the three-person team on the About page (Rifky Bujana Bisri, Alifais Farrel Ramdhani and Satria Ridho). It is counted at that size because it has outside backing, a live paid product and a signed distribution partner. Geography: LinkedIn gives Jakarta Selatan as its headquarters; no street address is published, so the row is pinned to the city. Two of the three list Vancouver, Canada, on their own LinkedIn profiles (both studied at the University of British Columbia), and LinkedIn places the workforce in Canada and Indonesia. The row is counted in Jakarta because the operating company, its registration, payments, partner and press are Indonesian, and its president director signed the Sivali agreement in Jakarta. Liveness: netraruntime.com answered on 17 Oct 2026 with a 2026 copyright, terms updated 26 May 2026 and a privacy policy updated 15 Sep 2026; the product went live on 18 Jun 2026, per Rifky Bujana Bisri's LinkedIn post that day; the Sivali agreement followed on 6 Oct 2026. Doubtful: Init 6's round, amount and date have not been announced; one quote in Metro TV's story also calls Rifky Bujana Bisri Sivali's vice president of technology, which the other three stories do not repeat; the site names "GSC" as its exclusive licensing partner for private deployments without saying what GSC is. Namesakes: several unrelated Indonesian companies carry "Netra" in their names (for example PT Netra Teknologi Nusantara in South Tangerang and PT Netra Prima Indonesia in Sukoharjo); Netra Runtime is not connected to them.
